note: دیکھنے is an inflected/oblique infinitive form of دیکھنا and must provide the lexical meaning see/watch/look rather than only grammatical labels.
proposed_english: to see; to watch; to look at; seeing/watching (oblique infinitive form)

note: آر is the name/representation of the Latin letter R. 'Content word' is not a POS.
خط means letter/correspondence but also line, handwriting/script, or route/line in compounds. The basic 'line' sense is omitted.
شاعر means poet. 'Humorist; traditional comedian' is source contamination and should not be taught as core Urdu meaning.
نوجوان means young/youthful adjectivally and a young person/youth as a noun. The noun meaning is missing despite noun POS.
سن is a major homograph: age/year/date (san) and the informal imperative 'listen!' from سننا (sun). The source lists only age and misses both highly common uses.
proposed_english: age; year/date; listen! (informal imperative of سننا, context-dependent)

note: ون represents the English loan 'one' in compounds and can also mean forest/wood in literary vocabulary. 'Content word' is not a POS.
proposed_english: one (English loan, especially in compounds); forest/wood (literary)

note: تبدیل means change/alteration/conversion or changed/converted in participial use. The source mixes noun and English verb glosses while marking noun only.
دوبارہ is the adverb again/anew/once more, not an adjective.
proposed_english: again; anew; once more; a second time

note: ہفتے is an inflected form of ہفتہ and must state week/weeks rather than only grammatical labels.
قیادت means leadership/command/guidance. 'Constituency' is not a normal direct meaning and should be removed.
اثر means effect/influence/impact/impression. 'Impress' is an English verb and not a direct noun gloss.
چین is a major homograph: peace/rest/comfort/relief, China, and the English loan chain. The everyday peace/rest meaning is entirely missing.
proposed_english: peace; rest; comfort; relief; China; chain (loanword, context-dependent)
